stories.title: Firefox on iPhone Can Now Block Ads and Trackers Without Installing an Extension
stories.description: Mozilla added a built-in Ad Blocker to Firefox on iOS, blocking many third-party ads and ad trackers without extensions.

stories.title: GitSpawn Flaws Let Malicious Repositories Execute Code in Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and Grok
stories.description: A newly disclosed class of vulnerabilities, dubbed GitSpawn, allows a booby-trapped repository to silently execute code on a developer's machine the moment it is opened with an AI coding agent, no prompt typed, no approval clicked, and in some cases before…

stories.title: Hackers Target US and EU Firms With Microsoft 365 Session Hijacking and RMM Abuse
stories.description: A wave of cyberattacks across the US and Europe in August exploited the trust businesses place in everyday tools, turning Microsoft 365 logins, remote-management software, and routine business documents into entry points for attackers.

stories.title: UK Moves to Block High-Risk Tech Suppliers From Critical Infrastructure
stories.description: Late amendments to the Cyber Security and Resilience Bill would give ministers new powers to restrict risky technology providers as supply chain attacks intensify.

stories.title: Dropbox Says 5,000 Accounts Were Compromised Through Lenovo ID Authentication Flaw
stories.description: Dropbox has disclosed that approximately 5,000 user accounts were compromised in August after attackers exploited a weakness involving its Lenovo ID sign-in integration.

stories.title: Malicious .git Configs Can Make Claude, Codex, Cursor, and Other AI Agents Run Attacker Code
stories.description: Eight Git config flaws let received repositories run commands through seven AI coding agents; four remained unpatched at publication.

stories.title: Malicious Apache Modules Hijack Brazilian Government Site Traffic to Push Betting Pages
stories.description: Gambling Goblin installs malicious Apache modules on Brazilian public-sector servers to reverse-proxy visitors to gambling pages.

stories.title: BGP Hijack Delivers Malicious Virtualizor Update That Establishes Persistent Root Access
stories.description: A BGP hijack delivered a malicious Virtualizor update; one provider found root compromise on five of 34 checked hypervisors.

stories.title: Rockwell Automation Patches Over a Dozen Vulnerabilities Across Products
stories.description: The industrial giant has released advisories for its RSLinx Classic, ArmorStart, ControlFLASH, FactoryTalk, and other products.

stories.title: Meta Ads Push StreamRat Android Trojan That Can Gain Near-Complete Device Control
stories.description: StreamRat uses fake streaming ads to reach Spanish-speaking Android users and enables device takeover after sideloading and permission grants.

stories.title: Exploit Published for Fresh Cleo Harmony Vulnerability
stories.description: The security defect allows remote attackers to bypass authentication through argument bearer manipulation.

stories.title: Anthropic Details Response to Security Incidents, Unveils Enterprise Safeguards
stories.description: Anthropic introduced Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS), a system that combines zero data retention with automated monitoring for misuse.

stories.title: Microsoft Plugs Nearly 400 Security Holes
stories.description: Microsoft today released updates to remedy at least 398 security vulnerabilities in its Windows operating systems and supported software, including one weakness that is already being actively exploited and two others that were publicly detailed prior to today.
